Message:
KVM: x86/vPMU: Enable PMU handling for AMD PERFCTRn and EVNTSELn MSRs

This patch enables AMD guest VM to access (R/W) PMU related MSRs, which
include PERFCTR[0..3] and EVNTSEL[0..3].
